title: Translator writes locale output using unconstrained language and directory inputs
description: The translation pipeline forms output paths from a caller-controlled locales directory and language string. A crafted language containing path separators may escape the intended locale directory and overwrite an arbitrary writable JSON path.
claimed_root_cause: Output path construction concatenates untrusted locale and directory values without canonical containment validation.

trace.description: The CLI accepts locale/output configuration from caller input.
Language values are interpolated into a filesystem path.
The generated path is written as a locale file.

evidence.description: processTranslations writes path.join(localesDir, `${lang}.json`) without a containment check.

blockers: Exact line and caller reachability need bounded local fixture validation.
Filesystem permissions and intended CLI trust boundary are outside source.

validation_plan.local: In a disposable directory, pass a language such as ../../probe and verify the resolved write stays inside localesDir and no outside file is created.
validation_plan.deployment: Review who can invoke the CLI and which workspace paths are writable during translation jobs.
